findings.novelty: Reverified current AY2026–2027 rate; not dated as a new November policy
facts: Undergraduate YourPace tuition is USD 1,800 per eight-week session for AY2026–2027.
One, two, and three paid sessions produce tuition scenarios of $1,800, $3,600, and $5,400, excluding any other applicable charges, outside credit costs and aid; no completion guarantee.
The same tuition page still advertises a $10,200-or-less degree example. Six sessions at the current rate are $10,800, so the older example should not be adopted as current arithmetic.

findings.novelty: Previously documented November17; no newly adopted policy date established
facts: No fixed number limits incoming transfer records; course applicability is program-specific.
Bachelor residency is at least 30 credits through UMPI, including at least 12 in the major; at least 9 of those 12 are at 300 level or above.
For a 120-credit degree, 30-credit residency implies at most 90 outside applicable credits; it is not a promise of 90 ACE credits.

Current generic CPL page includes ACE-recommended learning from non-accredited training organizations among CPL methods and caps combined bachelor CPL at 30 credits. Process page and linked handbook also state 30.
The ACE page directs official ACE transcripts through CPL/PLA evaluation. A published named Sophia equivalent does not itself override aggregate caps or guarantee degree placement.
notEstablished: Whether UMPI administers any approved Sophia/Study.com course equivalency outside the published combined CPL30 limit for a specific YourPace cohort.
A formally adopted current-cohort exception, new effective date, or automatic grandfathering rule.

findings.novelty: Reported possible policy transition; no primary dated text established
claimLeads: ACE cannot satisfy major requirements after a transition.
Automatic grandfathering for prior enrollees or awards submitted before cutoff.
findings.observedBoundary: No dated December28 policy or blanket ACE-to-major prohibition was located in the opened official ACE, CPL, FAQ, or linked handbook sources. Exact catalog was inaccessible. Forums are leads only.
findings.action: Do not invent the cutoff, impose a blanket major prohibition, reopen historic student awards, or change student's saved progress. Keep current degree-placement and cohort exceptions unresolved until an authoritative university document identifies the exact scope.

facts: Milestones may include assignments, quizzes, and activities; proficiency unlocks the final assessment. The final assessment determines course grade, with an optional draft for feedback.
Passing requires Proficient level; handbook grade scale identifies 3.0/80% as the minimum and maps passing proficiency to letter grades.
Undergraduates normally start with two courses and may have four active at once; submitting a final permits a request for another. Courses must be completed within the session.
FAQ requires webcam and microphone for recorded presentations, voiceovers and video assignments. It does not establish a universal no-proctoring guarantee.
notEstablished: Course-specific current business syllabus, final-assessment format, live/recorded obligations, or universal absence of proctoring.

findings.novelty: Official announcement updated from July2025 proposals; three approvals November2025 active Fall2026
facts: Current official update identifies exactly three NECHE-approved programs active Fall2026: UMA Applied Public Administration, UMFK Applied Business Management, UMPI Applied Psychology.
Initial July2025 announcement proposed five pilots. Applied College Studies and Applied Liberal Studies must not be presented as available based solely on that proposal.
System framework restricts enrollment to adult degree completers with prior credit after at least two years away; current program-specific pages refine eligibility.
At least 30 credits must come from the conferring campus. For a 90-credit award, arithmetic allows at most 60 applicable outside credits (66.7%), not automatic 60 ACE credits.
notEstablished: Current course-by-course executable transfer mappings for these three exact awards.
A universally applicable ACE allowance or guaranteed graduate-school/employer acceptance.

facts: Applied BA Psychology is designed for adult completers returning after a two-year pause with prior college credit or CPL.
Curriculum is 40 general-education credits, 45 psychology/core credits and at least 5 elective credits; at least 30 awarded by UMPI, including substantial advanced major work.
University warns some employers/graduate programs require 120 credits, and the program does not directly lead to clinical psychology licensure or counseling credentials.
No-loss transition to the 120-credit Psychology BA is described; federal aid may not be available after earning the 90-credit degree then returning for 120.
findings.action: Retain as editorial opportunity and program discovery only; do not manufacture applicable Sophia/ACE placements.

facts: Official page titles award Applied Bachelor of Science in Business Management (90 credits); system announcement names subject Applied Business Management.
Admission requires GPA2.0, official transcripts, at least30 completed college credits and two-year education gap OR transfer from a community college entered as an adult degree completer.
30 UMFK credits required. Curriculum has36 general-education plus54 business credits and eliminates electives.
Courses are seven-week asynchronous, with six starts per academic year. This is not a self-paced flat-subscription claim.

Transparency disclosure warns some employers/graduate programs may reject fewer than120 credits; UMFK describes its own master's pathway subject to all graduate admission requirements and no-loss transition to120-credit BS.
findings.action: Use exact award and eligibility terms in editorial; hold executable template until full curriculum/assessment and applicable transfer origins are verified.

facts: Applied BS Public Administration (90-Credit) page requires minimum two years relevant work experience OR prior college credit OR CPL evaluations; at least two years since most recent credits; work-experience credit requires CPL portfolio; standard undergraduate admission and2.0GPA apply.
At least30 credits at UMA; every completed credit carries into UMA's full121-credit Public Administration degree.
Program can be entirely online; some HyFlex courses allow in-person, live online, or independent scheduling. No universal self-paced or nonproctored guarantee established.
Page shows resident tuition328/credit, out-of-state784/credit and advertised total39,360. The total equals120×328, not90×328; do not publish it as a reconciled90-credit total.
findings.action: Use admission review boundary because the page's experience/credit alternatives differ from the broad original framework; do not invent a universal age or prior-credit minimum. Obtain exact degree-specific fee/tuition estimate before a cost comparison.
